children.value: > Fact From Story: Wang said that in response to the reporting an emergency meeting was called between Bankman-Fried, Wang and Singh, to discuss shutting down Alameda. He said they ultimately decided against such a move, because he and Bankman-Fried were aware that Alameda had no way to repay the roughly $14 billion hole in its books.
> > Fact From Story: Wang testified against Bankman-Fried.
> > > > > Fact From Story: Wang said that his crimes, including wire and commodities fraud, were carried out with the help of Bankman-Fried.
> > > > > Fact From Story: Wang was technology chief for FTX.
> > > > > Commonsense Knowledge: A technology chief would have a good understanding of the company's finances.
> > Fact From Story: Alameda had no way to repay the roughly $14 billion hole in its books.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: People generally do not testify against people unless there's an issue.
> Commonsense Knowledge: If a company cannot repay its debts, it has a large hole in its books.
